name: Zankoku na Imomushi no Tsubushikata
original_name: 残酷ないもむしのつぶし方
source:
A story about boys who want to become a girls and a beautiful doctor.
It's said this legendary female doctor gives handsome boys sex change operations for free.
Instead, her fee is tormenting the boys and giving them pain.
If they can hold on 'til the very end, she'll make them the girls that they hope to become.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ049643.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个关于想成为女孩的男孩和一个美丽的医生的故事。
据说这位传奇女医生免费给帅哥做变性手术。
相反，她的报酬却在折磨男孩们，给他们带来痛苦。
如果她们能坚持到最后，她会让她们成为她们希望成为的女孩。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ049643.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
